overview: Vaudreuil-Dorion grew 13.5 percent between 2016 and 2021, from 38,117 to 43,268 residents. The Boulevard de la Gare and Chemin Dumberry sectors have grown strongly, and the number of residents who speak only English rose sharply.

The city is the main shopping and industrial centre for Vaudreuil-Soulanges, and a large new regional hospital is adding to its job base. Local businesses compete with national retailers in busy commercial zones, but newcomers are still choosing their regular providers.
